description: mu (μ): most of what a coding agent decides isn't code. mu hands 40 kinds of yes/no calls to a small model: fewer wasted tokens, fewer approvals on autopilot, fewer runs that stop halfway. Built on pi.
summary: mu (μ): a coding agent that thinks before it acts. A small, fast judge makes the routine calls, the big model does the work. Built on pi and AionUi.
